units.source_text: 正殿檐前，正是藤花盛开之处。

en.t: In front of the main hall's eaves was just where the wisteria flowers were in full bloom.

units.source_text: 为了看花，正殿的格子窗都开着，众侍女群集在帘前。

en.t: To view the flowers, all the lattice windows of the main hall had been opened, and many ladies-in-waiting gathered before the blinds.

units.source_text: 她们故意把衣袖裙裾露出帘外，像新年里举行踏歌会时那样。

en.t: They deliberately let their sleeves and skirt hems show beyond the blinds, just as at the New Year treading-song celebration.

units.source_text: 这态度和今天的内宴颇不相称。

en.t: This manner was rather out of keeping with today's private palace banquet.

units.source_text: 于是源氏公子想起了藤壶院的斯文典雅，觉得毕竟与众不同。

en.t: Then Prince Genji thought of Fujitsubo's refined elegance and felt that she was, after all, different from the rest.
